checks.routeSource: Independent manual reasoning over the fully visible authored diagrams; no production solver, pilot or state writes.

methodology: Compute radial proposals geometrically, reject all original shared destinations, then enumerate every movement subset with pre-pulse occupancy closure and acyclic dependencies. Compare its unique maximum against production across all crate-array permutations. Separate boundary fixtures verify terminal/input rules. Three independently derived routes use ordinary inputs with every pulse checked by the oracle.
limitations: Bounded fixture coverage and accelerated ordinary-input model routes are separate from real runtime gameplay and recording; modelElapsedSeconds is not recorded video duration. No continuous magnetic-force simulation is claimed.
